messages:
Iris: dropping a fresh concept 'deployment ribbon' for the rollouts page. trying to reduce vertical space while keeping timeline scrub & rollback controls visible. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/new/ribbon-ux (page: ribbon-compact)

Jon: nice concept. question: how does the scrubber behave with dense histories? do we virtualize or compress?

Meera: compress older ranges into a collapsed band, with a +/- to expand month buckets. keep the scrubber linear for the recent 30 days.

Chris: microcopy: the inline action currently reads "Rollback" which triggered panic in tests. suggest "Restore" or "Route back". shorter -> better.

Iris: leaning "Restore". also thinking a tiny confirmation inline so users can undo without a modal (eg toast with "Undo").

Jon: inline confirm is OK for small changes, but for cross-region rollbacks we need the full modal. rule: if change affects >1 region or >50% traffic, show modal.

Meera: accessibility: the ribbon should be a role=listbox with each version as role=option. keyboard: Home/End jump to ends, arrows move one version, Enter opens details. focus ring must be visible at 2px.

A11yCheckerBot: Automated scan: contrast fail on the pale orange rollback tag at 11px. Recommend darker #b45a00 or use outline.

Chris: thanks. visual note: canary knob shows traffic slider inline. when <5% use a dot + tooltip, otherwise show a mini bar. avoids clutter.

Iris: good. re: copy inside scrubber tooltip: show short context: "v2.11  deployed 3h ago \u2014 10% canary". keep to one line.

Jon: performance: expansion panels in ribbon may cause reflow. prefer overlay panel anchored to the ribbon item to avoid pushing content.

Meera: agree. overlay helps with virtualization too. ensure overlay is keyboard reachable and focus traps to panel while open.

Chris: small UX experiment: add a tiny progress ring to active versions showing health (green/orange/red) with sr-only text. ring size 16px to keep density low.

Iris: sounds good. action items: 1) change "Rollback" -> "Restore" 2) add inline undo toast 3) overlay panel instead of inline expansion 4) toggle visuals for <5% traffic 5) update a11y contrast and role attributes.

Meera: i'll add role listbox example and keybinding table to the doc: Home/End, Arrows, Enter, Esc, Space toggles canary.

Jon: i'll validate edge perf on older laptops and mock a 1k-version history in the spike.

A11yCheckerBot: Created ticket RED-3420: "Deployment ribbon: listbox role, overlay panels, contrast fixes, performance spike" https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/RED-3420

Iris: thanks all 60a i'll update figma and push the copy changes.

Chris: small final ask: add aria-live updates when traffic changes: "Traffic for v2.11 now 25%" so screen reader users get realtime context.

Meera: will include.

Iris: awesome, closing this thread for now. will ping when mocks are updated. :sparkles:
